skill_definition.cell: mean over q10, q50, q90 of the pinball loss against the truth at origin + horizon
skill_definition.pooled: 1 - (mean cell loss / mean baseline cell loss) over every scored cell (equal cell weights; the track text's definition; scale-dependent, so high-priced volatile series weigh more)
skill_definition.mean_of_series: mean over series of (1 - series loss / series baseline loss); series whose baseline loss is exactly 0 are excluded; unbounded below when a series barely moved
skill_definition.geomean: 1 - exp(mean over series of log(series loss / series baseline loss)), ratio floored at 0.001; scale-free and symmetric in over- and under-performance
